Grievous grows impatient; we must deliver the prototypes."<br />"But we're just not ready!"<br />"Our concerns are of little consequence to General Grievous.|A [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoan]] combat [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] and the main [[Techno Union scientist]]|<ref name="Clone Wars Chapter 24">{{CW|24}}</ref>}}
'''Combat engineers''' were [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoans]] that worked in the science of combat engineering. They worked on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nelvaan/Legends|Nelvaan]] for [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. There they performed crude experiments on the native [[Nelvaanian/Legends|Nelvaanians]], turning them into hideous mutated [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborgs]] using a unique form of microelectronics and [[3L41UH7 serum|3L41UH7 mutagenic serum]] for General Grievous to call them his [[Izvoshra/Legends|elite]] and for the war. The engineers were either hurt or killed by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] before they could escape the planet in their [[Hardcell-class interstellar transport/Legends|''Hardcell''-class interstellar transport]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Skakoan combat engineers were voiced by [[James Arnold Taylor]], while the main Techno Union scientist was voiced by [[Nick Jameson]].
